framework for object instance segmentation. Our approach
efficiently detects objects in an image while simultaneously
generating a high-quality segmentation mask for each in-
stance. The method, called Mask R-CNN, extends Faster

parallel with the existing branch for bounding box recogni-
tion. Mask R-CNN is simple to train and adds only a small
overhead to Faster R-CNN, running at 5 fps. Moreover,

proposal numbers, which is beyond the scope of this paper.

has finer strides (e.g., 4 pixels on the finest level), RoIAlign

creases APkp by 4.4 points. This is because keypoint detec-

indicates that alignment is essential for pixel-level localiza-
tion, including masks and keypoints.
Given the effectiveness of Mask R-CNN for extracting
object bounding boxes, masks, and keypoints, we expect it
be an effective framework for other instance-level tasks.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline outcomes use official held-out benchmark protocols including COCO test-dev, minival, and Cityscapes val/test sets, established external metrics independent of training.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard COCO mask, box, and keypoint AP metrics on held-out COCO test-dev and minival, plus Cityscapes val/test AP.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Supervised multi-task losses involving ground-truth box, class, mask, and keypoint annotations on COCO and Cityscapes training data.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims regarding superior accuracy, state-of-the-art results on benchmark suites, and running speeds (around 5 fps) are well-aligned with and directly substantiated by the reported empirical tables and timing measurements.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The framework is evaluated rigorously against standard competitive benchmarks on COCO (instance segmentation, object detection, human pose estimation) and Cityscapes, supported by extensive ablation studies isolating the effects of RoIAlign and mask decoupling.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Evaluation is conducted using official standardized benchmark test servers and held-out validation sets (COCO test-dev, minival, Cityscapes test).
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Standard COCO and Cityscapes average precision (AP) metrics evaluated across multiple IoU thresholds on held-out test and validation sets.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Supervised gradient descent optimizing multi-task losses (classification, bounding box regression, and per-pixel binary cross-entropy/softmax mask loss) on annotated ground-truth datasets.

primary.limitations: The authors identify trade-offs such as the heavier runtime of C4 backbones relative to FPN, slight degradation in box/mask accuracy when jointly training human keypoints, and domain shift effects in low-data regimes on Cityscapes.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, describing the RoIAlign operation to avoid spatial quantization via bilinear interpolation, multi-task loss formulation decoupling mask and category prediction, and network backbone instantiations.
primary.quality_rationale: Mask R-CNN provides an exceptionally clear conceptual contribution, complete and reproducible technical descriptions, and thorough empirical validation across multiple vision tasks with rigorous ablations.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces Mask R-CNN, an instance segmentation framework extending Faster R-CNN by adding an RoI-aligned FCN branch that outputs binary masks in parallel with bounding box classification and regression.

scholarly_quality.rationale: Mask R-CNN provides an exceptionally clear conceptual contribution, complete and reproducible technical descriptions, and thorough empirical validation across multiple vision tasks with rigorous ablations.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors identify trade-offs such as the heavier runtime of C4 backbones relative to FPN, slight degradation in box/mask accuracy when jointly training human keypoints, and domain shift effects in low-data regimes on Cityscapes.
